name: mul_op
lean_statement: def mul_op {G : Type*} [Group G] (a b : G) : G := a * b

name: inv_op
lean_statement: def inv_op {G : Type*} [Group G] (a : G) : G := a⁻¹

name: conjugate_by
lean_statement: def conjugate_by {G : Type*} [Group G] (g a : G) : G := g * a * g⁻¹

name: commutator
description: Group commutator: a⁻¹ * b⁻¹ * a * b
lean_statement: def commutator {G : Type*} [Group G] (a b : G) : G := a⁻¹ * b⁻¹ * a * b

name: square_op
lean_statement: def square_op {G : Type*} [Group G] (a : G) : G := a * a

name: mul_assoc_theorem
lean_statement: theorem mul_assoc_group {G : Type*} [Group G] (a b c : G) : a * b * c = a * (b * c)

name: mul_one_theorem
description: Multiplying by the identity element gives the same element
lean_statement: theorem mul_one_group {G : Type*} [Group G] (a : G) : a * 1 = a

name: mul_inv_cancel_theorem
description: Multiplying by the inverse gives the identity
lean_statement: theorem mul_inv_cancel_group {G : Type*} [Group G] (a : G) : a * a⁻¹ = 1

name: inv_inv_theorem
description: Double inverse is the identity: (a⁻¹)⁻¹ = a
lean_statement: theorem inv_inv_group {G : Type*} [Group G] (a : G) : a⁻¹⁻¹ = a

name: inv_mul_rev_theorem
description: Inverse of a product reverses the order: (a * b)⁻¹ = b⁻¹ * a⁻¹
lean_statement: theorem inv_mul_rev_group {G : Type*} [Group G] (a b : G) : (a * b)⁻¹ = b⁻¹ * a⁻¹

name: mul_left_cancel_theorem
description: Left cancellation: a * b = a * c implies b = c
lean_statement: theorem mul_left_cancel_group {G : Type*} [Group G] (a b c : G) (h : a * b = a * c) : b = c

name: mul_comm_abelian
description: In an abelian group, multiplication is commutative
lean_statement: theorem mul_comm_abelian {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] (a b : G) : a * b = b * a

name: group_hom_def
description: A group homomorphism preserves the group operation
lean_statement:
-- Group homomorphism: a function f such that f(a * b) = f(a) * f(b)
-- In Mathlib: MonoidHom (or →* notation)
example {G H : Type*} [Group G] [Group H] (f : G →* H) (a b : G) : f (a * b) = f a * f b := map_mul f a b

name: subgroup_closure
description: A subgroup is closed under multiplication and inverses
lean_statement:
-- Subgroup: a subset closed under multiplication, inverses, and containing 1
-- In Mathlib: Subgroup G
example {G : Type*} [Group G] (S : Subgroup G) (a b : G) (ha : a ∈ S) (hb : b ∈ S) : a * b ∈ S := S.mul_mem ha hb
